title: Bucket Protocol V2 — Sui CDP v2 (version/import + oracle + liquidation)
closed_reasons: explicit on-chain version gate: usdb::assert_valid_module_version<T>(&Treasury, v) rejects versions not in valid_versions
value movement is a witness-gated request/response flow; liquidate only builds an UpdateRequest (no transfer)
v1->v4 bytecode diff is rounding/bookkeeping, not gating
key_facts: live custody: CDP collateral ~$25.37M across 21 Vault<T>; PSM pools ~$2.46M; total ~$27.8M (DL $27.84M)
version gate present from v1 (package_version()=1) and in v4 (=2); vault calls assert_valid_package 7x in v1, 9x in v4
structs byte-identical v1->v4 (layout gate does not protect old code)
caveats: the CDP allow-list still authorises version 1 — latent, not a proven drain
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Bucket Protocol V2 ($27.8M custody); the version/import primitive is mitigated by an explicit version gate bound to the Treasury, though the CDP allow-list still authorises package version 1 (latent risk).
